snippet.title: Cosmic Fear | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
You’ve discovered evidence of a cosmic presence influencing humanity since its origins. Now something born in the depths of the cosmos is calling again. Investigate, uncover forbidden knowledge and survive a disturbing first person Lovecraftian horror adventure.
BUY IT NOW:
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306920/Cosmic_Fear/
EPIC STORE: https://store.epicgames.com/p/cosmic-fear-9b5472
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards
